description: CRC32 conditions: a required item with its module's CRC32 among others, a required item without it (the group is invalid), an optional one without it (a warning), a forbidden module that is loaded with another CRC32 (a hint) and without a CRC32 (the group is invalid), a CRC32 list without a valid entry, CRC32s in lower case and with spaces.
settings: Selection="Crc match","Crc mismatch","Optional mismatch","Forbidden mismatch","Forbidden present","Bad crc list"
